ABOUT_DESCRIPTION:
I have been building websites for several years, with the majority of my experience focused on creating and managing WordPress sites. I take pride in delivering projects that are visually appealing, fully functional, and tailored to each client's needs. 

 Alongside WordPress, I enjoy programming with modern frontend technologies like Next.js, crafting websites from scratch with precision and creativity. My approach combines attention to detail, practical solutions, and a focus on user experience, ensuring every website looks professional and works seamlessly for businesses and individuals alike.

AMMDE_OVERVIEW: Website for AMMDE, the multi-sector association of women executives and entrepreneurs. An institutional space to give the association visibility, communicate its mission and activities, and help attract new members.

DRIVELANDM_OVERVIEW: Website for Driveland Motorsport, specialists in performance automotive tuning and services. A site with character, designed to engage motorsport enthusiasts and present the company's services.

IOR_CHALLENGE: A healthcare site has to inspire immediate trust and make sensitive information easy to find without overwhelming. A large amount of clinical content —services, specialists, technology— had to be organised legibly and accessibly, with interactions that lighten the reading.
IOR_SOLUTION: I built the site with WordPress and Elementor so the client could maintain content independently, and reinforced specific sections with custom jQuery to reveal and hide information dynamically. The result is a tidy site with clear visual hierarchy and simple navigation between services and team.
IOR_FEATURES: Independent content management with WordPress + Elementor
Custom jQuery interactions to reveal content
Clear presentation of services, medical team and facilities
AMMDE_CHALLENGE: The association needed a professional digital presence it could update itself, able to communicate its values, showcase events and turn visitors into members.
AMMDE_SOLUTION: I built the site with WordPress and Elementor, with a clear structure for mission, events and member benefits, and a simple interface so the team can manage content without relying on a developer.
AMMDE_FEATURES: Structure focused on mission, events and member acquisition
Professional design aligned with the association's identity
SOTOBP_CHALLENGE: A consultancy sells on credibility: areas of expertise and work had to be communicated with a clean design that projects solvency, avoiding the generic template look.
SOTOBP_SOLUTION: I built the site with WordPress and Elementor, with a modern, refined design that highlights services, team and completed projects and guides visitors toward getting in touch.
SOTOBP_FEATURES: Clean, corporate design focused on credibility
Clear presentation of services and areas of expertise
DRIVELANDM_CHALLENGE: The challenge was translating the energy of the motorsport world to the web while keeping service and vehicle information tidy and easy to browse.
DRIVELANDM_SOLUTION: I built the site with WordPress and Elementor, with a bold, visual design showcasing services, team, vehicles and events to attract new clients.
DRIVELANDM_FEATURES: Bold, visual design matching the motorsport world
PORTFOLIO_CHALLENGE: I wanted a portfolio that wouldn't look like yet another template —something alive and detail-crafted, with solid performance, accessible and bilingual, without sacrificing smooth animation.
PORTFOLIO_SOLUTION: I built it with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion, with a scroll-driven work section (a 3D cube rotating through projects), es/en internationalisation via next-i18next, light/dark theme and carefully tuned micro-interactions.
COFRADIA_OVERVIEW: Official website for the Hermandad de la Divina Pastora, currently in development. The project goes beyond an informational site: it integrates a CMS so the brotherhood can manage its own content, plus foundations for member management, legal content and a store.
COFRADIA_CHALLENGE: A brotherhood needs a site it can maintain itself, with rich, structured content, while laying the groundwork for more complex features (members area, store, documents) on a modern, secure architecture.
COFRADIA_SOLUTION: I'm building it with Next.js 16 (App Router) and TypeScript, using Sanity as a headless CMS for editable content, Clerk for authentication, Neon (serverless Postgres) for data and Resend for email —all deployed on Vercel with a branch-based workflow and preview deployments.
COFRADIA_FEATURES: Foundations for members area and store
